title: An ended session shows the sign-in page without error messages
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as an Admin (the Admin role can see every page used below).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders in tab 1.
  2. Open a second tab of the same browser on the same site and sign out there.
  3. Go back to tab 1 and click Reports > Inventory Value.
  4. Read the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Tab 1 takes you to the sign-in page (or asks you to sign in again).
  • No pile of red error messages appears, and no work orders or report rows are left showing.
  • After you sign in again, the page shows current data.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 8; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08); PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 8: “Impersonation and session expiry, on any page.”
  • Dev reply 8: “Start and exit impersonation while a page is loading. There should be no stale data, and no error toasts from cancelled requests.”
